item.title: One Chicago Podcast - Greg Van Horn (Merlin)
item.description: I absolutely loved this podcast episode; I am so glad that we found out about Merlin. We have heard a lot about him in previous episodes and it was great to finally get to hear from him. It was so cool to learn that the bullpen is designed using inspiration from different police stations to make it as authentic as it could be, ever since the first episode of Chicago PD it has always seemed like a real location. item.title: TV Show of the Year 2025: Cast Your Vote
item.description: It’s officially time for our annual Reader’s Mega Poll. This is your chance to decide which TV series will earn the title of Show of the Year! With 200+ shows in the running, you can vote for as many favorites as you want. If we missed a hidden gem, no worries, there’s an “Other – Leave Comment” option so you can make sure your pick is still counted. Cast your vote below, and don’t forget to drop a comment telling us why your choice deserves the crown. Poll closes December 31st at 11:59 p.m. EST
